classification: reviewer XML-check implementation fault, not figure content failure
diagnosis: Actual SVG arrows have shortened line shafts and explicit transformed triangle groups with data-arrowhead-for; they do not use a line marker-end attribute. Requiring the line shaft endpoint to equal the complete arrow tip was incorrect.
recovery: Only the reviewer-owned XML check was corrected to verify segment endpoints, shaft starts, triangle direction and transformed tip clearance. No candidate spec, SVG, preview, source or inherited evidence was edited; no rendering rerun.
